CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
August 24, 2021 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

5.1
90th BIRTHDAY RECOGNITION - It is recommended the City Council present Charles "Charlie" Santana with a 90th birthday recognition certificate.
5.1 90th Birthday Recognition
5.2
RECOGNITION OF CITY EMPLOYEES FOR YEARS OF SERVICE – It is recommended the City Council recognize Velma Nulod and Eric Villagracia for their years of service and present them with a service award pin and a certificate of appreciation.
5.2 Recognition of City Employees
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of August 10, 2021 and the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of August 10, 2021.
7.1 Minutes of 8-10-21 SS
7.1 Minutes of 8-10-21 CC
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated August 24, 2021 in the total amount of $1,801,188.75.
7.2 Warrant Register - City
7.3
APPROVAL OF THE LA MIRADA ARTS COLONY "MIRRORS OF YOUR MIND" ART EXHIBIT IN THE LA MIRADA ACTIVITY CENTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the request for the use of the La Mirada Activity Center from the La Mirada Arts Colony for the "Mirrors of Your Mind" art exhibit.
7.3 La Mirada Arts Colony Exhibit
7.4
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-06, PARKING LOT SEAL COAT FOR CITY FACILITIES - CIVIC CENTER, BEHRINGER PARK, FRONTIER PARK, VETERANS PARK, WINDERMERE PARK, NEFF PARK, CREEK PARK, GARDENHILL PARK, WILDERNESS AREA, PUBLIC WORKS WAREHOUSE, THEATRE WAREHOUSE, TRANSIT FACILITY AND 14515 ALONDRA BOULEVARD - REVIEW OF BIDS AND REJECTION OF ALL BIDS - It is recommended the City Council reject all bids for Capital Improvement Project No. 2021-06, Parking Lot Seal Coat for City Facilities and authorize the City Clerk to re-advertise for sealed bids.
7.4 CIP No. 2021-06
7.5
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING JULY 2021 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending July 2021.
7.5 Investment Report - July 2021
8.
PUBLIC HEARING
8.1
PUBLIC HEARING TO RECEIVE INPUT FROM THE COMMUNITY REGARDING THE REDRAWING OF ELECTION DISTRICT BOUNDARIES - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing to receive input from the community regarding the redrawing of election district boundaries.
8.1 Public Hearing - Redrawing of Election Districts
8.2
RESOLUTION NO. 21-26 APPROVING THE DEACTIVATION AND REMOVAL OF TRAFFIC SIGNALS AND REPLACEMENT WITH ALL-WAY STOP CONTROLS ON NORTH FIRESTONE BOULEVARD AT GATEWAY DRIVE, NORTHWOODS INN/IQ AIR DRIVEWAYS (585 FEET EAST OF GATEWAY DRIVE), AND TROJAN WAY - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as prescribed by law; adopt Resolution No. 21-26 approving the deactivation and removal of traffic signals and replacement with all-way stop controls on North Firestone Boulevard at Gateway Drive, Northwoods Inn/IQ Air Driveways (585 feet east of Gateway Drive), and Trojan Way; and authorize the City Manager to execute contracts as necessary for the deactivation and removal of the traffic signals and placement of all-way stop controls at the North Firestone Boulevard at Gateway Drive, Northwoods Inn/IQ Air Driveways (585 feet east of Gateway Drive), and Trojan Way.
8.2 Resolution No. 21-26 Removal of Traffic Signals
8.3
RESOLUTION NO. 21-27 ESTABLISHING A FEE FOR THE PREPARATION, PROCESSING AND APPROVAL OF AN AGREEMENT TO TEMPORARILY GRANT A LOCATION EXEMPTION FOR THE INSTALLATION OF AN ELECTRIFIED FENCE - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as required by law and adopt Resolution No. 21-27 establishing a fee for the preparation of an agreement to temporarily grant a location exemption for the installation of an Electrified Fence.
8.3 Resolution No. 21-27 Fee for Processing an Agreement for an Electrified Fence
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 718 SETTING CALIFORNIA PRIMARY ELECTION DATES AS THE CITY COUNCIL ELECTION DATES AS REQUIRED BY LAW - It is recommended the City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 718 setting California Primary Election dates as the City Council Election dates as required by law, by title only, and waive further reading.
9.1 Ordinance No. 718 - 2nd Rdg
9.2
SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 719 ADDING CHAPTER 2.35 TO THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE REGARDING ELECTRONIC FILING OF CAMPAIGN DISCLOSURE STATEMENTS AND STATEMENTS OF ECONOMIC INTEREST - It is recommended the City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 719 adding Chapter 2.35 to the La Mirada Municipal Code regarding electronic filing of campaign disclosure statements and Statements of Economic Interest, by title only, and waive further reading; approve an agreement with Netfile to implement an electronic filing system for campaign disclosure documents and Statements of Economic Interest in the amount of $4,100 annually; and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
9.2 Ordinance No. 719 - Second Reading
9.3
RESOLUTION NO. 21-28 AUTHORIZING A BUDGET AMENDMENT FOR THE GRANT PROGRAM FOR SHUTTERED VENUE OPERATORS - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 21-28 authorizing a budget amendment for the Grant Program for Shuttered Venue Operators for Fiscal Year 2021-22.
9.3 Resolution No. 21-28
